property_summary: For any caller and amount, only the contract owner can change betLimit via AdjustBetAmounts in the correct contract (non-owner calls must not change betLimit); the mutant that relaxes onlyOwner allows a non-owner caller to successfully change betLimit, so for some fuzzed caller/amount the post-call betLimit will differ from the reference behavior.
change_summary: Relax onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller by removing the require check (no owner restriction), which can change who can call AdjustBetAmounts and thus who can change betLimit.
